title: Musk pledges to give 'every kid in America' one of his SpaceX shares | TechCrunch
summary: Musk owns around 849 million Class A common shares of SpaceX, and more than 5.5 billion Class B supervoting shares. Musk’s philanthropic giving to date has been almost exclusively done through his own Musk Foundation.
